title: VMF plan run status
description: PLANRUN-1: what a signed-off plan is doing next, written by the facade's timer at plan-run.json in the run's top level. The timer decides every five minutes whether the next wave starts; this records the latest answer so the run page can say it, and so the run log gains a line only when the answer CHANGES rather than every pass.

reason.description: start: the timer started the next wave. The others say why it did not: the run is paused; a wave is running; a machine waits for a person; the first wave has not been started; the next wave has a start time; the next wave fails an engine gate; every wave has run.

detail.description: The sentence the run page shows

wave.description: The wave started, when reason is start

execution.description: The engine execution started, when reason is start
